requirements.title: CHARACTER_STORAGE_SIZE gives the character storage unit size in bits
requirements.source: S16.10.2.5 p1 value relation; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF472.
requirements.definition: CHARACTER_STORAGE_SIZE is a default integer scalar constant whose value is the size in bits of the character storage unit.

pending.character-storage-size-default-integer-s: Import CHARACTER_STORAGE_SIZE, assert KIND(CHARACTER_STORAGE_SIZE) equals KIND(0), RANK(CHARACTER_STORAGE_SIZE) equals 0, and CHARACTER_STORAGE_SIZE is positive; mutate the imported name to FILE_STORAGE_SIZE.
pending.character-storage-size-matches-storage-s: Compare CHARACTER_STORAGE_SIZE with STORAGE_SIZE('A') for the default character literal 'A'; assert equality and mutate the literal to an integer exemplar so the relation is load-bearing.

requirements.title: The character storage unit bit count is processor dependent
requirements.source: S16.10.2.5 p1 cross-reference to 19.5.3.2; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF472.
requirements.definition: The standard fixes CHARACTER_STORAGE_SIZE as the bit count of the character storage unit, while the actual character storage-unit size is processor dependent.
